romans.10.p1.b1.text: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.

romans.10.p1.b2.text: For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.

romans.10.p1.b3.text: For Christ is the end of the law, to bring righteousness to everyone who believes.

romans.10.p2.b1.text: The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart …

romans.10.p2.b2.text: that if you confess with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord,” and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.

romans.10.p3.b1.text: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”

romans.10.p3.b2.text: For there is no difference between Jew and Greek: The same Lord is Lord of all …

romans.10.p3.b3.text: for, “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

romans.10.p4.b1.text: … And how can they believe in the One of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone to preach?

romans.10.p4.b2.text: And how can they preach unless they are sent?

romans.10.p4.b3.text: As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!”

romans.10.p5.b1.text: … Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.

romans.10.p5.b2.text: I was found by those who did not seek Me; I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me.

romans.10.p5.b3.text: But as for Israel he says: “All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and obstinate people.”
